lines.t: Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
Wind in the tree, stars like fire above
Walking these streets alone
But wrapped in his love, one step and another Heavy heart gone live, whisper his name
And the dark turns bright Come to hell, let it all go
Lay it down, he already know Empty hands, but your heart overflow
Look at the stars, as high as mercy glows Every tear, every scar, he reclaims
Every fall, rewritten by his name Come to him, let go of shame
Lose yourself and rise again
I left my house when the night felt hard
Thought I was lost, it was never far
Code went spoke like a prophet's tone
Child surrendered on all Cologne
I looked up, I seen galaxies spin
Thought how small am I, yet he calls me in
The same one who made Orion's flame
Knew my heart before I had a name
I let go of pride of the pain I chased
Let the dust wash clean from my face
Felt peace move deep like a river inside
No words, your spirit sanctifies us
Come to him, let it all go
Lay it down, he already know
Empty hands, but your heart overflow
Look at the stars, that's how his mercy glow
Every tear, every scar he reclaimed
Every fall, written by his name
Come to him, let go of shame Lose yourself and rise again
Told him to sing that I tucked away He said, son, I've already paid
The guilt, the fear that I thought so tall He broke with love, shattered it all
I breathe in peace, I breathe out past The weight I wore, gone at last
The sky stretched wide like his open arms Every star singing faith disarms
I ain't that same man came out here
Cause when he near, all shadows clear
The world might mock, but I found truth
In a quiet night, I found proof
Hands to heaven, hardly bear
His voice around the midnight
Every still, my son, behold
Be free, I was always here, come and see
No fear, no chain, no enemy wind
Just light inside where dark had been
The stars don't fade, they testify
Rain forever, that's reason why
Come to him, let it all go
Lay it down, he already know
Empty hands, but your heart overflow
Look at the stars, that's how his mercy glow
Look into every scar he reclaimed
Every fall, rewritten by his name
Come to him, let go of shame
Lose yourself and rise again
Under these stars I found my song But surrender made the broken strong
The road's still dark but my steps now blade Walking with him in all my days
Let go, receive, let the spirit in This is the night where I'll begin
The heavens whisper, not far, not dim Be still, my child, come to Him
